theory_records.title: Additive performance allowance
theory_records.claim: If pre-layout process values lie in [Pmin_proc,Pmax_proc] and every value receives the same shift dP, specification [L,U] requires L-Pmin_proc <= dP <= U-Pmax_proc.
theory_records.assumptions: A common additive shift; use scenario-specific response otherwise.

theory_records.title: Coupled parasitic feasible region
theory_records.claim: Independent allocations of per-parasitic limits can exclude electrically acceptable combinations; direct performance constraints preserve those tradeoffs.
theory_records.assumptions: The response model and specifications define feasibility; a linearized region is only local.

theory_records.title: Signed local sensitivities and adjoints
theory_records.claim: dPj is approximated by sum_i Sji dXi. An adjoint computes derivatives with respect to many parameters for one scalar response.
theory_records.assumptions: Differentiable local response; suitable simulator convergence; independent responses generally need independent adjoints.

theory_records.title: Resistance and geometric capacitance models
theory_records.claim: A uniform rectangular segment has R=Rsheet L/W; overlap, lateral and fringing capacitance have distinct geometry-dependent contributions.
theory_records.assumptions: Calibrated material/layer/environment; L and W use the same units; contacts/vias and nonuniform current need additional modeling.

theory_records.title: Area and distance mismatch terms
theory_records.claim: The cited pair model is variance=Aq^2/(WL)+Sq^2 D^2, with structure/orientation/environment constraints used alongside it.
theory_records.assumptions: Process-calibrated pair model and its geometry domain; coefficients are not universal foundry constants; common centroid does not remove the finite-area random term.

theory_records.title: Separate symmetry move groups
theory_records.claim: Position, orientation and shape relationships are distinct; coordinated translations, swaps, flips and axis movement can preserve chosen relationships by construction.
theory_records.locator: §§4.6–4.7: constraint groups and translation, swap, flip and symmetry-axis moves
theory_records.assumptions: Compatible group membership, fixed-object conditions and legal variants; preserving one relationship does not prove neighbor clearance or electrical matching.

theory_records.title: Annealing temperature calibration
theory_records.claim: For fixed energy and symmetric proposals, uphill acceptance is exp(-dE/T); T0≈-mean(positive dE)/ln(p0) is an initial calibration heuristic.
theory_records.assumptions: T>0, 0<p0<1, consistent energy units, finite search; exp of mean does not equal mean acceptance. No finite-run global optimum guarantee.

theory_records.title: Segment current and via capability
theory_records.claim: Required wire width and via count depend on current carried by each route segment and on process current capability.
theory_records.assumptions: Current scenario and branch topology must be known; waveform, temperature and current sharing require the relevant reliability model.

theory_records.title: Defect critical area is a separate yield model
theory_records.claim: For long parallel wires with length L and spacing s, bridging critical area is L max(0,chi-s); expected faults integrate critical area against defect density, with Poisson no-fault probability exp(-lambda).
theory_records.assumptions: chi is defect diameter; simplified long-wire geometry omits detailed end effects; density and Poisson assumptions must be calibrated; not parametric mismatch yield.

theory_records.title: Sequence-pair symmetry is a sufficient subset
theory_records.claim: For one common vertical symmetry axis, pos_alpha(x)<pos_alpha(y) iff pos_beta(sym(y))<pos_beta(sym(x)) is a sufficient symmetric-feasible sequence-pair condition, not a necessary condition for physical symmetry.
theory_records.locator: Balasa, Chapter1 §1.3, Eq. (1.1); sufficient-not-necessary discussion PDF50
theory_records.assumptions: Source sequence convention, distinct group members, reflected partner mapping; multiple groups need compatible embedding (§1.3.2 PDF60–61).

theory_records.title: Connected symmetry islands restrict the search
theory_records.claim: A symmetry island is an abutting connected group. ASF-B-star stores representative half-groups and reconstructs counterparts; self-symmetric representatives touch the axis.
theory_records.locator: Lin and Chang, §§2.2.2–2.3.1, Definition2.1, Lemma2.1 and Property2.1
theory_records.assumptions: Legal module envelopes and chapter-specific B-star convention; connectivity/abutment is stronger than geometric symmetry.

theory_records.title: DTI legality is disjunctive and coupled
theory_records.claim: The DTI example permits a shared range or a sufficiently isolated range, excludes intermediate gaps, and limits a middle device total left-plus-right stretch.
theory_records.assumptions: Technology-specific DTI semantics and finite geometry bounds; not every isolation rule has these branches.

theory_records.title: Shape functions preserve alternatives within a decomposition
theory_records.claim: Ordinary horizontal composition gives (w1+w2,max(h1,h2)); enhanced shapes retain B-star topology and can interlock contours. Hierarchical enumeration does not enumerate all circuit layouts.
theory_records.assumptions: Fixed hierarchy and variants; composition constraint-preservation assumes no incompatible added parent constraints; geometric dominance is not automatically electrical dominance.

theory_records.title: Difference constraints versus general linear relations
theory_records.claim: An acyclic fixed-order graph solves xj-xi>=dij by longest paths; symmetry relations involving sums/differences of more variables require a richer linear representation.
theory_records.assumptions: One-dimensional fixed ordering with appropriate graph feasibility; LP optimality concerns the stated model, not all topology choices or nonlinear electrical effects.

theory_records.title: Layout-aware sizing and surrogate domain
theory_records.claim: Each sizing can select geometric parameters, instantiate or model layout parasitics, and evaluate the resulting circuit. A naive table with m samples in n dimensions has m^n entries.
theory_records.locator: Castro-López et al., §6.3.3 flow; §6.4.2 shape propagation; §6.5.1 extraction approaches A/B; Table6.7
theory_records.assumptions: Fixed characterized template/technology/model domain; sensitivity screening reduces sampling but cannot certify omitted parasitics in all future contexts.

theory_records.title: Constraint lifecycle and meta-verification
theory_records.claim: Management, derivation, transformation, sensitivity analysis and verification are distinct services; static final verification uses fixed design and constraint data.
theory_records.assumptions: Applicable rules and model coverage must be defined; DRC/LVS alone do not express all analog intent; transformations can restrict the remaining design space.

theory_records.title: Yield over all operating conditions
theory_records.claim: Yield is probability over statistical fabrication variables that every specified performance bound holds for every operating-range condition.
theory_records.assumptions: Declared joint statistical distribution and complete range contract; a sampled operating point or process-corner list alone is a different analysis.

theory_records.title: Covariance propagation and valid dependence
theory_records.claim: For local response f≈f0+S(x-mu), Cov(f)≈S C S-transpose; a scalar sensitivity column g gives variance g-transpose C g.
theory_records.assumptions: Finite second moments; exact for affine response, approximate for nonlinear response. C must be PSD, inverse whitening requires positive definiteness or a reduced-rank subspace.

theory_records.title: Linear ellipsoidal worst case
theory_records.claim: For delta-transpose C-inverse delta<=beta^2 and f=f0+g-transpose delta, extrema occur at delta=±beta Cg/sqrt(g-transpose Cg) and f=f0±beta sqrt(g-transpose Cg).
theory_records.assumptions: Positive-definite C, beta>=0 and g-transpose Cg>0; zero gradient/variance requires separate treatment; nonlinear circuits need validated approximation.

theory_records.title: A sigma distance needs its probability region
theory_records.claim: A standardized n-dimensional Gaussian radius-beta ball encloses P(chi-square_n<=beta^2); a symmetric independent box encloses [2Phi(beta)-1]^n; one linear upper bound has probability Phi(beta).
theory_records.assumptions: Independent standardized coordinates for box product; positive signed margin for usual passing example; joint circuit yield is an intersection, not automatically any of these regions.

theory_records.title: No-failure confidence is not perfect yield
theory_records.claim: With N independent Bernoulli trials and no failures, a one-sided 95% upper failure-probability bound is 1-0.05^(1/N); ordinary Monte Carlo yield variance is Y(1-Y)/N.
theory_records.locator: §6.1.1 Eq. (219), §6.1.3 Eqs. (225)–(226); confidence limit is derived here
theory_records.assumptions: Independent, identically distributed complete pass/fail events; not the variance formula for weighted importance samples or unresolved simulation outcomes.
theory_records.derivation_if_any: P(no failures|p)=(1-p)^N; solve (1-p)^N=.05. N=3000 gives 0.00099808; a 1 ppm upper bound requires at least 2,995,731 clean independent trials.

theory_records.title: Mean-shift centering has a limited parameter interpretation
theory_records.claim: For Gaussian process covariance fixed and acceptance region fixed, gradient_mu Y=Y C-inverse(mu_accepted-mu). A stationary positive-yield point matches the accepted and original means.
theory_records.assumptions: Unconstrained mean variation, fixed covariance and fixed region; necessary stationarity only. Width/topology changes normally alter the region and cannot be substituted without chain rules.

theory_records.title: Correct regularized least-squares transpose
theory_records.claim: With residual e in R^m and row-gradient Jacobian J in R^(m by n), the regularized linear least-squares step satisfies (J-transpose J+lambda I)r=-J-transpose e.
theory_records.locator: §7.2.3 Eq. (362) and printed Eqs. (365),(368); printed pp.158–159
theory_records.assumptions: Local residual linearization, lambda>=0 and suitable solve/rank treatment; source RHS omits transpose, verified in actual raster. Not a global circuit-optimum certificate.
theory_records.derivation_if_any: Differentiate one-half ||e+Jr||^2 + lambda/2 ||r||^2. Gradient J-transpose(e+Jr)+lambda r=0. RHS must have n components.

theory_records.title: Full nonlinear Lagrangian curvature
theory_records.claim: For L=f-lambda(beta^2-delta-transpose C-inverse delta), Hessian_delta L=Hessian f+2lambda C-inverse; covariance curvature alone does not establish nonlinear second-order sufficiency.
theory_records.locator: §5.4 Eq. (189), prose following Eq. (191); AppendixC.6 Eq. (C.24)
theory_records.assumptions: Twice differentiable f, constant positive-definite C and fixed multiplier for Hessian; constrained sufficiency concerns appropriate feasible/critical directions. The prose omission was verified in raster.
theory_records.derivation_if_any: Differentiate the displayed Lagrangian twice with respect to delta. The objective-curvature term vanishes for affine f, or at a point where its Hessian happens to be zero; it cannot generally be omitted. Also, lambda>=0 alone is not strict positive curvature.

theory_records.title: Electrical centroid uses normalized comparison weights
theory_records.claim: For the difference of weighted responses to a shared affine spatial field, equal zeroth and first moments cancel that field. Ratio comparisons first normalize each group by its intended total; equal raw device counts are not necessary.
theory_records.locator: §2.7.2 common-centroid motivation; contrasting geometric area-weighted group center in Topological §3.1.1 Eq. (3.12), PDF112
theory_records.assumptions: Same local field and proportional unit response; comparison weights encode the intended ratio. Second-order fields, unequal environments and routing bias are not canceled by first moments alone.
theory_records.derivation_if_any: For q(r)=q0+g dot r, weighted difference=sum_i a_i q(r_i)-sum_j b_j q(r_j)=q0(sum a-sum b)+g dot(sum a r-sum b r). Both coefficients must vanish; normalize group weights for mean/ratio comparison.
